units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. Assessment is conducted once every three years.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. Assessment is conducted once every three years.”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. The following municipal servants are not subject to assessment:
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. The following municipal servants are not subject to…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) those who have held municipal service positions for less than one year;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) those who have held municipal service positions for less…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) those who have reached the age of 60;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) those who have reached the age of 60;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) those on maternity leave or on leave to care for a child until the child reaches the age of three. Such municipal servants may be appraised no earlier than one year after returning from leave;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) those on maternity leave or on leave to care for a child…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4) pregnant women;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4) pregnant women;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5) those with whom a fixed-term employment agreement (contract) has been concluded;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5) those with whom a fixed-term employment agreement (contract)…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 6) those within one year after being awarded a class rank.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6) those within one year after being awarded a class rank.”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. Organisation of assessment
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. Organisation of assessment”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. To conduct assessment, a municipal legal act is issued by decision of the employer’s representative (employer), containing provisions on:
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. To conduct assessment, a municipal legal act is issued by…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) approval of the assessment schedule;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) approval of the assessment schedule;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) formation of the assessment commission;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) formation of the assessment commission;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) preparation of the list of municipal servants subject to assessment;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) preparation of the list of municipal servants subject to…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4) preparation of documents needed for the assessment commission’s work.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4) preparation of documents needed for the assessment…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The assessment commission includes the employer’s representative (employer) and/or municipal servants authorised by that representative (including personnel and legal service staff).
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The assessment commission includes the employer’s…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: The assessment commission may include representatives of scientific and educational organisations and other organisations invited by the employer’s representative (employer) as independent experts specialising in municipal service matters, without specifying their personal data. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of the total membership of the assessment commission.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “The assessment commission may include representatives of…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. The assessment commission for municipal servants whose official duties involve the use of information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws is formed taking account of federal legislation on state secrets.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. The assessment commission for municipal servants whose…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. The assessment commission consists of a chair, deputy chair, secretary and commission members.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. The assessment commission consists of a chair, deputy chair,…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: All assessment commission members have equal rights in decision-making. A meeting is quorate if at least two thirds of the total commission membership are present.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “All assessment commission members have equal rights in…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: A municipal servant’s membership of the assessment commission is suspended for the period of that servant’s assessment.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “A municipal servant’s membership of the assessment commission…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. When municipal servants holding principal municipal service positions are assessed, the head of the municipal formation and a representative of the authorised executive body of the City of Moscow may be included in the assessment commission.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. When municipal servants holding principal municipal service…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 6. Assessment is conducted according to an assessment schedule specifying:
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6. Assessment is conducted according to an assessment schedule…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) the list of municipal servants subject to assessment;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) the list of municipal servants subject to assessment;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) the date, time and place of assessment;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) the date, time and place of assessment;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) the date for submitting to the assessment commission a report on the municipal servant’s professional activity (hereinafter, the report), specifying the head of the relevant local self-government body unit responsible for submitting it.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) the date for submitting to the assessment commission a…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 7. The assessment schedule is communicated to each municipal servant subject to assessment against signature at least 30 days before assessment begins.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “7. The assessment schedule is communicated to each municipal…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 8. At least 14 days before assessment begins, a report for the assessment period signed by the immediate head of the unit where the municipal servant works (hereinafter, the manager) is submitted to the assessment commission.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “8. At least 14 days before assessment begins, a report for the…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 9. The report must contain the following information:
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “9. The report must contain the following information:”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) surname, first name and patronymic;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) surname, first name and patronymic;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) the municipal service position held at the time of assessment and the date of appointment to that position;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) the municipal service position held at the time of…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) a list of the main matters (documents) in whose resolution (development) the municipal servant participated;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) a list of the main matters (documents) in whose resolution…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4) a reasoned assessment of the municipal servant’s professional, business and personal qualities and professional activity results.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4) a reasoned assessment of the municipal servant’s…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 10. At each subsequent assessment, the municipal servant’s assessment sheet containing the previous assessment results is also submitted to the assessment commission.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “10. At each subsequent assessment, the municipal servant’s…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 11. At least 7 days before assessment begins, the personnel service of the local self-government body must familiarise every municipal servant subject to assessment with the report submitted for their assessment period. The servant may send the assessment commission additional information on their professional activity during that period, a written statement disagreeing with the report, or an explanatory note concerning it.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “11. At least 7 days before assessment begins, the personnel…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 12. The assessment commission may postpone assessment to another day if:
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “12. The assessment commission may postpone assessment to…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) on the assessment date, the municipal servant submits additional information on their professional activity during the assessment period;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) on the assessment date, the municipal servant submits…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) the municipal servant has submitted a written statement disagreeing with the manager’s report;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) the municipal servant has submitted a written statement…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) the municipal servant fails to attend the assessment commission meeting for a valid reason.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) the municipal servant fails to attend the assessment…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. Assessment procedure
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. Assessment procedure”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. Assessment is conducted with the municipal servant being assessed invited to the commission meeting. If the servant fails to attend without a valid reason or refuses assessment, disciplinary liability is imposed in accordance with federal municipal service legislation and the assessment is postponed to a later date.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. Assessment is conducted with the municipal servant being…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The assessment commission examines the submitted documents and hears statements by the municipal servant being assessed or, where necessary, their manager concerning the servant’s professional activity.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The assessment commission examines the submitted documents…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. Discussion of the municipal servant’s professional, business and personal qualities in relation to their professional activity must be objective and benevolent.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. Discussion of the municipal servant’s professional, business…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. Discussion of matters concerning a municipal servant’s private life or their attitude towards political or religious organisations is prohibited.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. Discussion of matters concerning a municipal servant’s…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. If additional time is needed for objective consideration of supplementary information submitted by the municipal servant about their professional service activity during the assessment period, the commission may postpone assessment until its next meeting.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. If additional time is needed for objective consideration of…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 6. When deciding whether a municipal servant is suitable for the position held, the assessment commission must take account of:
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6. When deciding whether a municipal servant is suitable for…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) their level of education and professional knowledge;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) their level of education and professional knowledge;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) the extent of the servant’s professional contribution to resolving the tasks assigned to the relevant local self-government body unit;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) the extent of the servant’s professional contribution to…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) the complexity and effectiveness of the servant’s work;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) the complexity and effectiveness of the servant’s work;”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4) the servant’s compliance with statutory municipal service prohibitions and restrictions and official conduct requirements;
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4) the servant’s compliance with statutory municipal service…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5) organisational abilities, when assessing a servant vested with organisational and administrative powers over other municipal servants.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5) organisational abilities, when assessing a servant vested…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 7. The assessment commission secretary keeps minutes recording the voting results and the commission’s decision. The minutes are signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and commission members present at the meeting.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “7. The assessment commission secretary keeps minutes recording…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. Assessment results
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. Assessment results”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. Following assessment, the commission decides whether the municipal servant is or is not suitable for the municipal service position held.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. Following assessment, the commission decides whether the…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The assessment commission may recommend rewards, including promotion, for individual municipal servants’ achievements at work and, where necessary, improvements to the work of those assessed. It may also recommend, on the basis of assessment results, that individual servants be sent for additional professional education.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The assessment commission may recommend rewards, including…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. The assessment commission decides in the absence of the municipal servant being assessed, by open vote and a simple majority of members present at the meeting. If votes are equal, the servant is deemed suitable for the municipal service position held.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. The assessment commission decides in the absence of the…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. Assessment results are communicated to the servants assessed immediately after the voting results are finalised.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. Assessment results are communicated to the servants assessed…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. Assessment results (the decision and recommendations) are entered in the municipal servant’s assessment sheet (hereinafter, the assessment sheet). The sheet is signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and commission members present at the meeting.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. Assessment results (the decision and recommendations) are…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 6. Assessment materials are forwarded to the employer’s representative (employer) no later than seven days after assessment.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6. Assessment materials are forwarded to the employer’s…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 7. A municipal servant is entitled to challenge the appraisal results in court.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “7. A municipal servant is entitled to challenge the appraisal…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 8. The assessment sheet, report, supplementary information submitted by the servant about professional activity during the assessment period, and any statement disagreeing with the report or explanatory note concerning it are kept in the servant’s personal file.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “8. The assessment sheet, report, supplementary information…”
